book.name: REVELATION
book.title: Matsh Haschu g Jesus Christ am i Maskogi John Wui

content: Mash g holiwek oꞌohana ch kahwal mad neid
Ni haha wabsh neid. Kuki an uꞌukch g holiwek oꞌohana s-apkojed e-nowi ed hegai mo an da kownal daikud t an. K wehsko oꞌohanas ab ab ihda ch wewaꞌakpa ab si bidshpi ch cheposidas.
Neid ani ehp g si s-gewk anghil. K heg si s-kaidam amog ch hab kaij, “Dohꞌo am hugkam apꞌedag mat wo e nako mat wo wantsh g chechposig k ab wo i kuhpiꞌo ihda oꞌohana?”
T wabshaba pi hedai e cheh an dahm kahchim ch ed ch in jewed dahm ch am jewed wecho mat wo e nakog k wo kuhpiꞌo k an wo i nei eda g oꞌohana.
Ni heg hekaj si pi ap ni-tahtk ch shoak.

K hab hahawa kaij hema hegam geꞌeged ab ni-wui, “Pi g am shoakad. Neh, Mawid Namkam at gewito g pi apꞌekam k hab wo e nako mat wo wantsh g wewaꞌak chechposig k ab wo i kuhpiꞌo g holiwek oꞌohana. Bo masma hab chuꞌig mo hab masma oꞌohadag mo id ab d Judabad amjedkam ch d ep Davidbad amjedkam.”

Kuni hahawa neid hegai moki hab ahg. K eda ihda Mawid Namkam hab masma ab i e chehgidch mo g kahwal mad ch atki heki hu e muhkid k idani am kehk si eda g kownal daikud. K an wehgaj gegok hegam giꞌik haꞌichu dodakam ch hegam geꞌeged. K hegai mo kahwalkaj ab e chehgidch wewaꞌak aꞌag ch wewaꞌak wuhpui. Idam wewaꞌak wuhpui o hab d ahga mat ab amjed i hih g Hekia S-apꞌekam Gewkdag k an wehsko neid ch nuhkud g Jiosh nahtoi.
T am hih hegai mo kahwalkaj ab e chehgidch k am bei g holiwek oꞌohana ab s-apko nowij ab hegai mo ab da kownal daikud t ab.

T ha hekaj ab wui i shul hegam giꞌik haꞌichu doakam ch hegam gokko gamai giꞌik geꞌeged. K idam wehsijj ge ahlipa ch ohla hohas-hahaꞌa. K hegam ha eda hohas-hahaꞌa s-ap uhw shuhdagi ch id d ha-hoꞌigeꞌidahuna g Jiosh hemajkamga.
K am hema aꞌaga g wechij neꞌi. K g ha-neꞌi hab chuꞌig:

content.text: “Ahpi ap geꞌe apꞌedag mapt wo e nakog k am wo bei g holiwek oꞌohana k wo wantsh g chechposigaj napt pi e muhkid k hekaj ab uhpam i ha ui g hemajkam am wehhejed g Jiosh.
K g m-uꞌi d wehsko dakam hemajkam ch d nahnko kaidam neneokdam ab wehs jejewed ha amjed.
Bapt ha juh mat wehs d wo papalk ch ab wo ihmad g Jiosh ch d wo kokownalk wehsko jewed dahm.”

content: Nt am hahawa nea k ha kah muꞌi mihl anghil. Idam o an wehgaj gegok g geꞌe kownal daikud am ha wehm hegam giꞌik haꞌichu doakam ch hegam geꞌeged
ch si s-kaidam neꞌe hab masma:

content.text: “Hegai mat kahwalkaj e muhkid o ab ab ulini mamt am wo i kei wehs haꞌichu dahm k ab wehs wo mah g s-kaisdag ch haꞌichu amichudadag ch gewkdag ch ab has elidadag ch hehgchulidadag ch hoꞌigeꞌidadag.”

content: Kuni ha kah g wehs haꞌichu doakam an dahm kahchim ch ed ch an jewed dahm ch am jewed wecho ch am geꞌe kahchki ch ed. Wehs idam o am neꞌe hab masma:

content.text: “Do ha wuikam g Jiosh heg wehm mat kahwalkaj ab e chehgidch mamb ab wo si pihk e elidad ha wui ch ab wo si has ha elidad ch ab wo ha hehgchulidad ch ab ha wui wo dagitokchid g e-gewkdag chum hekid.”

content: Tki hegam giꞌik haꞌichu doakam ab wohokamchud k hab kaij, “Am o wa woho ihda.” T g geꞌeged ab i shul wecho k ab si ihm.
